sourceSentences: [0] Ezreal is Jin favored. Ezreal loses pushed to Jin. The only way Jin Ezreal can win against Jin is all in it.

[0] if you will just keep keep pushed consistently against Ezreal, um and just push him under the tower, force him to use his mana on the wave, you will just kind of slowly whittle away his mana bar. He'll be unable to lane at past a certain point and you'll just slowly win.

[1] Maintenant, le matchup en soit, il est un peu free mais pour tous les deux en fait, il se passe pas grand-chose normalement dans matchupril ezril Jein. Donc je dirais que c'est un matchup assez free pour leil. Il peut il peut farm scale.
[1] c'est un matchup pour moi un peu à la jean, c'est free, vous pouvez scale, vous pouvez prendre vos way, il y a pas de problème. Et en plus de ça, s'il y a des angles, vous pouvez tuer.
[2] Be careful of Jhin’s Dancing Grenade(Q) that bounces off minions as well as his fourth basic attack!
[3] Avoid Mystic Shot(Q) by positioning yourself behind a minion!

[4] Playing Ezreal into Jhin is the same as playing any other champ into him. Don't leash as he has really good push, respect his 4th shot, stay a small distance away from minions to avoid his Q bounce.
[4] Jhin's long-range abilities and high burst damage can make it difficult for Ezreal to trade effectively. Jhin's Deadly Flourish can also root Ezreal in place, setting up for further damage.

[4] Jhin's Roots are Traps are a rough matchup for Ezreal due to the CC. Ezreal needs to have his E available to damage enemy champions. If he has to use it to escape any CC it leaves him vulnerable and inhibits his full burst potential.

[4] Should be easy lane match-up. Just be aware of his bullet count and W. In late game, don't get close to this guy or he will shred you. Poke with Q and finish up with Ult or dive with E if it's safe.
